## About
Bravo's Plumbing is a family business run by Benjamin Bravo, founder, owner and master plumber. He holds both his Journeyman and Master Plumbing licenses and started the company with the goal of keeping it small and personal.
Ben says running a small business means long hours, but it also lets him truly get to know his customers. The plumbing knowledge here has been passed down from father to son and on to everyone who works with him.
We serve Fort Worth and the surrounding areas, from water heaters and slab leaks to sewer lines and gas lines. We are licensed and insured, and we offer free estimates.

## Services
- Water heater repairs and installations: Repairs, maintenance and installations for standard and tankless water heaters.
- Leak repairs: Help with yard leaks, slab leaks and general plumbing repairs.
- Sewer and water line work: Sewer line and water line repairs, sewer cable cleaning and sewer camera inspections.
- Gas line testing and repair: Gas testing, gas line repairs and installation, plus hydrostatic testing.
- Toilet repairs and installations: Fixing leaking or broken toilets and installing new ones.
- Faucet, fixture and garbage disposal work: Garbage disposal work plus faucet and fixture installation.
- Bath and kitchen remodeling: Plumbing for bath and kitchen remodels.
- Water filtration: Water filtration system installation for your home.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. We offer free estimates.

Q: Do you offer a senior discount?
A: Yes. Just mention it at your time of service and we will apply the discount to your estimate.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Fort Worth and surrounding areas, including Saginaw, Haslet, Keller, Southlake, Haltom City, Lake Worth and Azle.
